'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Phillips LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Phillips]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)|VB4-L-watchyourstep-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WYS (V)
* '''Username:''' JosephPhillips
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
